column4: Updated Android checks and fixtures for apd stats device. These are development checks, not a gameplay feature.

Added where the history archive is saved and read from, through Android's system file picker (the Storage Access Framework): the player chooses the file, and the app gets a stream to exactly that file and nothing else.
Installed the Android document-picker provider for history transfers.
Updated build build configuration.
Updated the change descriptions bundled with this APK.
Added how the app reaches a file the player chooses: where an archive is saved and which one is imported.

Added writes the whole raw history to one ZIP archive: every run log and every imported-record file, and a manifest with a checksum of each, enough to rebuild everything derived (the index and the caches are not exported, they are rebuilt).
Added adds the history of an archive to this device's history.
Added the first entry of an APD history archive: what the archive holds and a checksum of every file, so an import can check everything before it keeps anything.

Added the device self-test for export and import: a small made-up history (one run not finished, with a hidden secret) is exported to a real file, imported into a second empty history, imported again, and a damaged copy of the archive is refused.
Added makes a copy of a run log that holds only what the player could know, for the archive of a run that is NOT finished.
Added a byte count in words ("1.4 MB").
Added how much room the recorded history takes and whether to say something about it.
Added the player's export and import of their history, and the storage meter, joined to the recorder.
Exposed the existing log fields needed for privacy-preserving archive export.
Added a StringLookup that is also told where in the payload each string reference ended, so a tool can rewrite the references (the archive renumbers the string table of a redacted log).
Kept redacted imported history distinguishable from complete local records.
Added history export/import actions and storage-usage information.
